title: Execution Grant
description: Authorisation contract binding a capability invocation to a run, an execution epoch, a permission scope, and an expiry.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run this grant belongs to.

execution_epoch.description: Unix timestamp (seconds, fractional) when the grant becomes active. Grants are invalid before this time.

permission_scope.description: Ordered list of permission tokens granted to this invocation.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds, fractional) after which the grant is void.
